entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Democratic People's Republic, a political institution in North Korea during Division of Korea and the Korean War (1945–1948). Grew from Korea divided at the 38th parallel between Soviet and American occupation zones and Armistice signed at Panmunjom — the war ends in stalemate. Led to the emergence of North Korea invades the South — Korean War begins and Chinese People's Volunteer Army enters the war, pushing UN forces south.
